snippet.title: The Surfer | Momentum based surfing | PS3
snippet.description: The Surfer combines high-speed momentum based surfing with big carves and air tricks on incredible waves from around the globe. The game features retro styled graphics layered upon real surfing physics with a true-to-life feel and sense of control – but powered up for arcade fun.
